Use a browser project with the three package installed and a module build tool. Each example creates its own canvas. Run one at a time. These library imports are not supported by this site's plain runner.

blocks.title: Move a group together

items: A Group is a parent transform for its children. Moving the group moves the child objects together.
A perspective camera needs a field of view, aspect ratio, near distance and far distance to describe its view.
`MeshBasicMaterial` gives a visible surface without requiring lights. It is useful for a first shape example.

blocks.text: Two cubes appear together, positioned as one group.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A child position is relative to its parent group. Keep local and world positions distinct.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Move the group upward and watch both cubes.
